text: I'll send you the runbook tomorrow
notes: Brian promising a deliverable. Hits I'll. tomorrow is the deadline but sits outside the by/before pattern.

text: I will ship the APIM wrap by EOD
notes: I will + by EOD deadline style.

text: ok, let me check the ECS logs and get back to you
notes: let me plus a concrete check. Classifier type is check; regex only cares that let me fires.

text: we'll decide by Friday on the rebase order
notes: we'll + decid + by Friday. Group phrasing, Brian in the we.

text: we will send the recap by Mon
notes: we will + by Mon deadline style.

text: waiting on Amber for the APIM DevEx wrap
notes: waiting on. Brian is owed.

text: blocked on the gateway health check from Alex
notes: blocked on. Same owed-to-Brian bucket.

text: I'll have the LiteLLM rotation notes up by 2026-09-18
notes: I'll + by ISO date deadline.

text: I'll get you the review by 2026-09-16
notes: Same I'll + ISO shape as Brian promising. Author is external; regex cannot see that. expected_type is what the classifier should emit later.

text: we're going to follow up before EOW with the forge module path
notes: we're going to + follow up + before EOW. Three patterns, one commitment.

text: we should probably revisit the gateway rotation next quarter
notes: Aspiration. we should is not we'll / we will / we are going to.

text: I sent it earlier this morning, should be in the thread
notes: Past tense. I sent is not I will. No deadline / waiting / follow-up token.

text: let me tell you why the APIM path is still messy
notes: Hits let me. Rhetorical, not a commitment. Regex prefilter is supposed to over-recall; the classifier drops it.

text: I'll circle back with the team
notes: Hits I'll and circle back. Meta, no deliverable. Classifier should emit null.

text: I'll grab coffee before standup
notes: Hits I'll. Not a work commitment.

text: let me think about that overnight
notes: Hits let me. No deliverable.

text: well, that's interesting
notes: well must not fire the we'll pattern. The apostrophe in we'll is load-bearing.

text: waiting on the AC repair at the house
notes: Hits waiting on. Personal, not a Liatrio commitment.

text: that's a nice follow-up question from the retro
notes: Hits follow-up. Noun phrase, not an intent to follow up.

text: we are going to the offsite lunch after the retro
notes: Hits we are going to. Lunch is not a delivery commitment.
